_comment: Curated subset for a separate GSC sitemap submission. /sitemap.xml stays complete because Bing indexes the whole site from it and sends ~100% of search traffic; shrinking it would damage the only working channel. This list exists so Google Search Console reports indexed-vs-submitted for the pages that matter as their own number.
_selection: top pages by GA4 sessions 2026-09-17..10-14 plus the newly built character pages and tier-1 hubs. Every slug is validated against src/data/pages by scripts/gen-sitemap-priority.py, which aborts on any slug that is not a real page or is a redirect source.
